newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan recovery not as strong as tankan result--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery not as strong as tankan result--BOJ.

text.p: The Japanese economic recovery has not strengthened as much as the improvement in business sentiment among major manufacturers shown in the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) June tankan survey, a senior BOJ official said on Wednesday.
The official said it was difficult to say that the economic recovery had become stronger just by the improvement in the diffusion index (DI) for major manufacturers alone.
"I don't think we can say that the economic recovery has become as strong as the improvement in the major manufacturers' DI," the official told Reuters.
The index is a key gauge of business confidence.
The official also said the improvement in the June figure, released earlier on Wednesday, was partly in reaction to a weak March index which reflected pessimism over the business outlook.
He also said the gap in business sentiment among various sectors had widened above his personal expectation in the June survey.

The BOJ's closely watched tankan quarterly survey of corporate sentiment showed that the DI for major manufacturers rose to plus seven in June from plus two in March, when the previous survey was conducted, and was above expectations.
But the DI for major non-manufacturers slipped a bit to minus seven in June from minus six in March.
